visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a bun, wearing a white tank top and a long brown skirt, prepares for a push-up on a wooden deck. The background features a large rope netting structure and natural light. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor room with a white dresser; the woman is now wearing a blue long-sleeved shirt and dark pants, performing a push-up on a light wood floor. (3) The setting shifts to a gym or dance studio with large windows and mirrors; the woman is in a gray hoodie and dark shorts, performing push-ups with improved form. (4) Outdoors in a public plaza near an orange hemispherical structure, the woman wears a large white sweater, black boots, and performs a push-up on stone tiles. (5) A dramatic transition occurs to a black studio background; a person in a realistic, grotesque 'Cart Titan' bodysuit with a mechanical turret on their back performs a push-up. The figure has an elongated face with a massive, toothy grin. (6) The character stands up, posing and flexing in the black studio with artificial smoke effects. (7) In a home kitchen setting with a refrigerator, the 'Cart Titan' character uses a long straw to drink from a large yellow cup, then later performs push-ups on a skateboard in the living area. (8) Back in the black studio, the character continues push-ups as text overlays the bottom of the frame.
